official_documentation_excerpt: Avatar Settings modifies underlying game defaults that are not visible outside of the settings interface or accessible with scripts.
manual_r6_path: File > Avatar Settings (or Avatar tab) > top bar ... > R6; save settings, publish, join a fresh server.
r6_fallback_evidence: Legacy Roblox R6 default IDs; runtime playability is checked by AnimationTrack.Length with an eight-second timeout. No authenticated live asset fetch or Studio playback verification was available.
original_custom_asset_permissions: Not accessible from this workspace; no claim that those private IDs are permitted for the published experience.
original_controller_findings: Enabled StarterPlayer/StarterCharacterScripts/Animate is a custom R6 controller with unconditional asset loads before its update handler.
LoadAnimation calls have no pcall or async zero-Length handling in the original.
MovementAnimationController is intentionally not initialized by ClientMain.
Actual uploaded Animate has no WaitForChild(Torso) call.
Crouching and FallSystem are disabled in the uploaded place.
